children: International Gemological Institute and BEML moved the Nifty 500 higher at market open on Friday, November 27, while Jupiter Wagons, Hyundai Motor India and Voltas slipped lower.

shares rose over 7% at market open before paring gains. The stock had risen almost 16% since the beginning of the year and more than 16% in the past year. It was at a 5.5% decline from its 52-week high of ₹2,236. Over 2 lakh shares were traded at 1.40 times the stock's 10-day average.

shares rose 5.3% before paring gains at market open after a large block deal in the pre-open window, in which shares worth ₹281 crore changed hands at ₹417 a share. The deal was for 67.16 lakh shares, or 1.55% of the company's equity, and promoter entity BCP Asia II Topco Pte Ltd was the likely seller.

On Thursday, the company had informed the exchanges that the promoter planned to sell this stake to meet minimum public shareholding requirements. The stock had risen more than 30% since the beginning of the year and more than 32% in the past year. It was at a 4.3% decline from its 52-week high of ₹453.65. Over 12 lakh shares were traded at 1.48 times the stock's 10-day average.

shares fell 5.7% at market open after trading higher for two straight sessions. The stock had risen as much as 20% in Wednesday's trade, after the company announced on Monday an agreement with Korea's Woojin Industrial Systems for a joint venture in India to make metro coaches and propulsion systems, in which it would hold an 80% stake.

The stock had fallen more than 32% since the beginning of the year and more than 22% in the past year. It was 34.1% away from hitting its 52-week low of ₹169.08. Over 1 crore shares were traded at 0.63 times the stock's 10-day average.

shares fell over 3% at market open. The stock had fallen almost 12% since the beginning of the year and 12% in the past year. It was at an 18.8% decline from its 52-week high of ₹2,420 and 22.8% away from hitting its 52-week low of ₹1,658. Over 2 lakh shares were traded at 0.30 times the stock's 10-day average.

shares fell 2.43% at market open. The stock had fallen more than 14% since the beginning of the year and more than 15% in the past year. It was 27.3% away from hitting its 52-week low of ₹930.50. Over 3 lakh shares were traded at 0.22 times the stock's 10-day average.

title: Nifty 500: BEML jumps 7%; Jupiter Wagons falls 5.7% after two-day rally
